# ThoughtForge

> Local-first AI planning assistant for macOS. Manage tasks, write notes, chat with a local LLM — no cloud, no tracking.

ThoughtForge is a free, open-source desktop app built with Tauri (Rust + React). All data is stored as plain Markdown and JSON files on your machine. Nothing is sent to the internet except the LLM calls, which go only to a local LM Studio instance running on localhost.

## Features

- Smart task dashboard with filters (My Tasks, Overdue, Due Today, Blocked)
- Kanban board: urgency, status, day-by-day, and calendar views
- Project spaces with notes, meetings, tasks, booked hours, and goals
- AI chat with a local LLM (LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible API)
- Document processing: upload transcripts and extract action items automatically
- Semantic search: vector-indexed notes powered by a local embedding model
- Time tracking: one-click timer, per-project hours, weekly timesheet
- SMART Goals: metric, target, current value, difficulty, due date — linked to projects
- Eisenhower Matrix: drag-and-drop task prioritization
- Built-in MCP server: connect Claude Desktop or any MCP client to your vault

## Tech stack

- App framework: Tauri 2.x (Rust backend + WebView frontend)
- Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- State: Zustand
- LLM: OpenAI-compatible API via LM Studio (localhost only)
- Semantic search: turbovec + local embedding model
- Storage: Markdown + JSON files — no database
- MCP: rmcp (Rust, stdio + HTTP transport)
